details.title: 9-Step Professional Workflow
items: 1. Fingerprint: Confirm whether target native library is written in Rust
2. Inventory: Map .so files, dependencies, ABIs, symbols, and imports/exports
3. Separate Runtime: Isolate standard/alloc/panic artifacts from app code
4. Recover Structures: Reconstruct structs, enums, trait objects, and state machines
5. Recover Execution: Build call graphs, CFGs, data-flow graphs, and thread models
6. Find Language Boundaries: Map Kotlin/Java ↔ JNI ↔ Rust ↔ C/C++ transitions
7. Correlate with Android: Link native logic to Activities, Services, and Framework APIs
8. Validate Dynamically: Validate hypotheses using runtime tracing and Frida hooks
9. Document: Produce complete subsystem architecture maps and confidence assessments
